About us

Move more,
worry less.

Motion is a Camden studio for sport and street wear – clothes we'd wear ourselves, from small labels and big names.

Our story

Made in Camden

Motion began in 2019 as a pop-up next to a boxing gym on Camden Lock. The coaches kept asking where to find kit that looked good outside the gym too – so we started making and stocking it.

Today we work with 30 labels, from small studios in Lisbon to the big names of running.

Questions

Frequently asked

How do sizes run?

True to size; leggings and sports bras fit snug.

Can I exchange a size?

Yes, free – we ship the new size when your return is scanned.

Do you ship abroad?

To the EU and US, 3 – 6 working days.

Which payment methods do you take?

Visa, Mastercard, PayPal and Apple Pay.

When do I get my refund?

Within 5 working days after the return arrives.

Can I change my order?

Within an hour – call +44 20 7946 0456.
